subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should the workflow owner accept the updated immutable Docker Login, Docker Buildx, CodeQL, and TruffleHog revisions for CI and credential-bearing container publishing jobs after verifying their upstream provenance?
rationale: The code change is third-party workflow execution in paths that receive registry credentials; accepting that supply-chain boundary is an owner decision rather than a mechanical contributor repair.

options.title: Verify and accept the pins
options.body: Confirm each SHA resolves to the stated upstream release, refresh the branch against current main, and merge after the resulting workflow checks pass.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Leave the PR open while the workflow owner chooses narrower or separately reviewed action upgrades for credential-bearing jobs.

recommendation.title: Verify and accept the pins
recommendation.body: Confirm each SHA resolves to the stated upstream release, refresh the branch against current main, and merge after the resulting workflow checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Docker release workflow work provides the strongest available ownership signal for the credential-bearing paths.
